author: Antonio Clim

decisions.numerical_traversal: Preserve the existing root FunctionDef/AsyncFunctionDef traversal. It includes root defaults, annotations and decorators (and parser-exposed type-parameter expressions); nested function, class and lambda nodes and their entire subtrees are skipped when not the root. Syntactic count only, not dynamic function execution or CFG.
decisions.evidence_remedy: Keep python_callable def-to-end scope for physical_span_lines. Give decision_point_count, mccabe_complexity and max_control_nesting_depth a separate python_callable_traversal locator, from the earliest root decorator AST expression lineno or def line to the callable end. This conservative line cover is not a minimal causal slice or complete compilable declaration.
decisions.parenthesised_decorator: The @ token or opening grouping line may precede the first AST expression line; the coverage claim concerns visited expressions, not all decorator punctuation.
decisions.failure: If a required decorator AST position is missing, invalid or outside source bounds, refuse with a dedicated CE04-LOC-001 MeasurementError; do not fabricate a full observed coverage. Existing ME-013 missing root span behaviour retained.
decisions.versions: Kernel/catalogue algorithm 1.1.1; only three traversal-backed observation specifications move to 1.1.1. Other 37 specification identifiers including physical span remain 1.1.0. New evidence scope requires updated schema and typed validation.
decisions.identity: Separate CE04 component inventory with explicit S05 baseline hashes and revised-component map. Historical S04 inventory remains unchanged. Native capsule/HTML identify new build honestly. No inherited CI result is assigned to new bytes.

claim_ceiling: Conservative source-line coverage of admitted syntactic traversal, not semantic soundness, minimal explanatory sufficiency, authenticated execution or educational utility.
